## Mock providers (local testing only)
Stands in for the outside services so the whole flow runs on this machine. Never publish in production.

Every "sent" Telegram message, CRM call and Graph lookup shows up in this workflow's **Executions**.

.env for mock mode:
TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN=mock
TELEGRAM_API_BASE=http://localhost:5678/webhook/mock-telegram
META_GRAPH_BASE=http://localhost:5678/webhook/mock-graph
CRM_PROVIDER=bigin
ZOHO_ACCOUNTS_URL=http://localhost:5678/webhook/mock-zoho
BIGIN_API_BASE=http://localhost:5678/webhook/mock-bigin

parameters.jsCode:
// Stands in for Zoho's OAuth refresh endpoint.
return [{ json: { access_token: 'mock-zoho-' + Date.now(), expires_in: 3600, api_domain: 'https://www.zohoapis.com', token_type: 'Bearer' } }];
